summary: The sidebar panel is comprehensive and well-implemented. It includes the AI category in the N-panel, multi-line prompt field with character count, Generate button, status display with progress indicator, script preview section with execute/cancel buttons, and a full history section with UIList. All features work together cohesively.

issues.description: The script preview only shows first 10 lines with truncation. This is noted in code but a scrollable text area or expand option might be more user-friendly for longer scripts.
The poll() method in AI_OT_Generate checks prompt length but the UI doesn't disable the button - it just shows error styling on the character count label. This is acceptable UX.

sharedStateObservations.description: Panel uses bl_category='AI' to appear in N-panel. Panel class naming follows Blender convention AI_PT_AssistantPanel.
History is implemented using CollectionProperty with a custom PropertyGroup (AIHistoryItem) and UIList (AI_UL_HistoryList) for proper Blender data management.
Scene properties are used for transient UI state (ai_prompt, ai_status, ai_is_generating, ai_current_script) following Blender's pattern for tool settings.
Operators properly implement poll() methods to enable/disable buttons based on state, and use bl_options={'REGISTER', 'UNDO'} for undo support.

The placeholder script generation in AI_OT_Generate._generate_placeholder_script() creates actual Blender objects (cube with material). This is more than a 'placeholder' - it's a working fallback for testing without API.
